underspecified_points.hole: The named FEniCSx physical-contract snapshot and the rules for its nondimensional reference quantities and frozen residual scales are not identified.
underspecified_points.fill: The authors must designate the authoritative model version and approve a manifest containing its geometry and tags, pulse segments and interfaces, constitutive functions, initial and boundary conditions, unit transforms, reference quantities, and the training-only rule that produces every frozen residual scale.

underspecified_points.hole: The analytic clock lacks an exact basis specification for `c_j` and `w`, a declared floating-point type, and a provenance-bearing value for `kref`.
underspecified_points.fill: The authors must lock the nondimensional knot locations and Gaussian spacing, select the floating-point type that defines `eps_dtype`, and define a strictly positive `kref` with units, source, and value before deriving `kfloor`.

underspecified_points.hole: The coefficient-network architecture and the training-validation score used to select `M_tau` from `{8,16,32}` are unspecified.
underspecified_points.fill: The authors must declare the input normalization, layer and activation specification for `a_psi(x)`, and one scalar training-validation selection rule for `M_tau`; `M_tau=16` remains the default and exact score ties must favor the smaller candidate.

underspecified_points.hole: The capacity-matched solution-head architecture and its output parameterization are not defined.
underspecified_points.fill: The authors must declare the shared trunk, layer and activation specification, output transforms for voltage, temperature, and phase, and the exact parameter-allocation target inherited by the matched arms.

underspecified_points.hole: The parameter-allocation rule and common training contract omit exact optimizer settings, stopping rule, and checkpoint-selection criterion.
underspecified_points.fill: The authors must lock the admissible head-size family and matching tolerance, all optimizer settings, update and stopping rules, and one in-distribution checkpoint-selection criterion, then apply that single contract to every arm.

underspecified_points.hole: The named comparator families do not have versioned, implementation-level definitions in the method view.
underspecified_points.fill: The authors must provide one frozen comparator manifest per baseline, naming its source or local implementation, architecture and transform, loss terms, trainable parameters, and the exact mapping to the shared physical, sampling, and selection contracts.

underspecified_points.hole: The physical-time metrics are named without their event thresholds, norms, normalizations, topology representation, or aggregation rules.
underspecified_points.fill: The authors must predeclare the field-error norm and reference alignment, switching event and crossing rule, phase-front level and Hausdorff convention, topology descriptor and distance, energy-balance normalization, and coupled-residual normalization and worst-case aggregation.

enriched_steps.what_changes: Serialize the existing two-dimensional device model as an immutable `PhysicalContract`. The record must contain the mesh and coordinate map, cell and facet tags, material-region assignments, pulse segments with one-sided values at every jump, constitutive callables with their declared arguments, initial data, boundary and interface conditions, dimensional units, and forward and inverse nondimensional transforms. Bind every later evaluator to one version of this record. 【author decision: designate the authoritative FEniCSx model snapshot and approve its complete physical-contract manifest, reference quantities, and residual-scale rules.】 Derive the dimensionless electrical, heat, and phase operators from that manifest without adding terms. Build a `ResidualScaleSpec` from training cases only, with a named scale for every interior, initial, boundary, constitutive, and pulse-interface residual, freeze it before validation scoring, and return the physical operators, pulse-interface table, unit transforms, and scale specification as read-only objects.
enriched_steps.what_to_do_en: Convert the existing two-dimensional device model into a read-only `PhysicalContract`. Store its mesh and labels, material regions, pulse segments and left and right values at jumps, material functions with their inputs, starting state, boundary and interface conditions, units, and both directions of every nondimensional conversion. Make every later step read the same version. 【author decision: designate the authoritative FEniCSx model snapshot and approve its complete physical-contract manifest, reference quantities, and residual-scale rules.】 Derive the dimensionless electrical, heat, and phase operators without adding a governing term. From training cases only, create and freeze a named scale for each interior, starting, boundary, material, and pulse-interface residual. Output the operators, pulse-interface table, unit conversions, and residual-scale specification.
enriched_steps.what_to_do_zh: 把现有二维器件模型整理成只读的 `PhysicalContract`。其中保存网格与标签、材料区域、脉冲分段及每个跳变处的左右单侧值、带明确输入的材料函数、初始状态、边界与界面条件、单位，以及每种无量纲换算的正向和逆向规则；后续步骤必须读取同一版本。 【作者需决定：指定权威 FEniCSx 模型快照，并批准完整物理合同清单、参考量和残差尺度规则。】 由该合同推导无量纲电、热和相态算子，不增加控制项。只用训练案例为每类内部、初始、边界、本构和脉冲界面残差建立有名称的尺度，并在验证评分前冻结。输出物理算子、脉冲界面表、单位换算和残差尺度规范。

enriched_steps.what_changes: Define a `ClockBasisSpec` containing the nondimensional time interval, fixed Gaussian centers `c_j`, common spacing `w`, floating-point type, `eps_dtype`, strictly positive `kref`, derived `kfloor`, and candidate set `{8,16,32}`. 【author decision: lock `c_j`, `w`, the floating-point type, and a strictly positive `kref` with units, source, and value before deriving `kfloor=sqrt(eps_dtype)×kref`.】 Evaluate a spatial-only coefficient network `a_psi(x)` that returns exactly `M_tau` coefficients and never reads a pulse value or predicted field. 【author decision: declare the coefficient-network input normalization, layers, activations, and the scalar training-validation score used to select `M_tau`; keep `M_tau=16` as the default and resolve exact ties toward the smaller candidate.】 Apply softplus to each coefficient, evaluate every Gaussian basis `b_j(t)` and its analytic error-function primitive `B_j(t)`, and form `tau_psi` exactly as E1. Obtain `partial_t tau_psi`, spatial gradients, and the spatial Hessian by analytic basis derivatives plus automatic differentiation through `a_psi(x)`; do not use a finite time integral. Return a `ClockState` with coefficients, basis values, `tau_psi`, its derivative tensors, the selected `M_tau`, and the frozen `ClockBasisSpec`.
enriched_steps.what_to_do_en: Create a `ClockBasisSpec` with the nondimensional time interval, fixed Gaussian centers `c_j`, shared spacing `w`, floating-point type, `eps_dtype`, strictly positive `kref`, the derived positive floor `kfloor`, and the choices `{8,16,32}`. 【author decision: lock `c_j`, `w`, the floating-point type, and a strictly positive `kref` with units, source, and value before deriving `kfloor=sqrt(eps_dtype)×kref`.】 Use a network `a_psi(x)` that reads position only and returns exactly `M_tau` coefficients; it must not read the pulse or any predicted field. 【author decision: declare the coefficient-network input normalization, layers, activations, and the scalar training-validation score used to select `M_tau`; keep `M_tau=16` as the default and resolve exact ties toward the smaller candidate.】 Make each coefficient positive with softplus, evaluate the fixed Gaussian functions and their analytic error-function cumulative functions, and form `tau_psi` exactly as E1. Obtain time and spatial derivatives from the analytic basis and automatic differentiation through the spatial network, never from a finite time integral. Return coefficients, basis values, the clock, all required clock derivatives, the chosen `M_tau`, and the frozen basis specification in `ClockState`.
enriched_steps.what_to_do_zh: 建立 `ClockBasisSpec`，记录无量纲时间区间、固定高斯中心 `c_j`、公共间距 `w`、浮点类型、`eps_dtype`、严格为正的 `kref`、由此得到的正下限 `kfloor`，以及候选集合 `{8,16,32}`。 【作者需决定：在推导 `kfloor=sqrt(eps_dtype)×kref` 前，锁定 `c_j`、`w`、浮点类型，以及严格为正的 `kref` 的单位、来源和数值。】 使用只读取空间位置的网络 `a_psi(x)`，使其恰好输出 `M_tau` 个系数，且不得读取脉冲或任何预测场。 【作者需决定：声明系数网络的输入归一化、层结构、激活函数，以及选择 `M_tau` 的单一训练—验证评分；默认 `M_tau=16`，完全并列时选较小候选。】 用 softplus 使每个系数为正，求值固定高斯函数及其解析误差函数累积形式，并严格按 E1 形成 `tau_psi`。时间与空间导数由解析基函数和对空间网络的自动微分得到，绝不使用有限时间积分。用 `ClockState` 返回系数、基函数值、时钟、全部所需时钟导数、选定的 `M_tau` 和冻结的基规范。

enriched_steps.what_changes: Represent the pulse protocol as a `PulseTrace` whose smooth segments expose `p(t)`, `p_dot(t)`, and `p_ddot(t)`, while every jump exposes separate left and right values and a stable `interface_id`. Pass `(x,tau_psi,p(t))` to one shared solution head `h_theta` with three outputs. 【author decision: declare the capacity-matched solution-head trunk, layers, activations, input normalization, and output parameterizations for voltage, temperature, and phase.】 Store the outputs as `V_hat`, `T_hat`, and `xi_hat` in a `FieldState`. Evaluate the physical spatial gradient of `V_hat` through the composite map, set `E_hat` from that gradient, apply the frozen conductivity to form `J_hat`, and contract current density with electric field to form `QJ_hat`; no learned auxiliary head may replace these deterministic relations. Return `FieldState` with the three fields, `E_hat`, `J_hat`, `QJ_hat`, the one-sided pulse record, and references to the clock and physical contract.
enriched_steps.what_to_do_en: Store the pulse as a `PulseTrace`. On every smooth segment it must return the pulse value and its first two time derivatives; at each jump it must return separate left and right values with an `interface_id`. Feed position, `tau_psi`, and the current one-sided pulse value to one shared solution head `h_theta` with three outputs. 【author decision: declare the capacity-matched solution-head trunk, layers, activations, input normalization, and output parameterizations for voltage, temperature, and phase.】 Save those outputs as `V_hat`, `T_hat`, and `xi_hat`. Derive electric field from the physical spatial gradient of voltage, current density from the frozen conductivity, and Joule heating from current density dotted with electric field. Return the fields, these deterministic derived quantities, pulse record, clock reference, and physical-contract reference in `FieldState`.
enriched_steps.what_to_do_zh: 把脉冲协议保存为 `PulseTrace`：每个光滑分段返回脉冲值及其一、二阶时间导数，每个跳变返回独立的左、右单侧值和稳定的 `interface_id`。将位置、`tau_psi` 和当前单侧脉冲值输入同一个三输出解头 `h_theta`。 【作者需决定：声明容量匹配解头的共享主干、层结构、激活函数、输入归一化，以及电压、温度和相态的输出参数化。】 把输出保存为 `V_hat`、`T_hat` 和 `xi_hat`。由电压的物理空间梯度得到电场，用冻结电导率得到电流密度，再由电流密度与电场的内积得到焦耳热；不得用学习得到的附加头替代这些确定性关系。用 `FieldState` 返回三个场、这些派生量、脉冲记录、时钟引用和物理合同引用。

enriched_steps.what_changes: Implement a `DerivativeBundle` for each scalar output of `h_theta(x,tau_psi,p)`. On an open pulse-smooth interval, use automatic differentiation to obtain partial derivatives with respect to direct spatial inputs, `tau_psi`, and every pulse component, together with all mixed and second derivatives required by E3 and E4. Assemble the physical first and second time derivatives with `p_dot`, `p_ddot`, the exact clock time derivatives, the mixed clock-pulse contractions, and the pulse Hessian contraction exactly as E3. Separately assemble the full physical `2×2` spatial Hessian with both mixed spatial-clock terms, the clock-gradient outer product, and the clock Hessian exactly as E4. Preserve the full Hessian tensor; form a Laplacian only by taking its trace, and form each divergence from its complete vector or tensor operand. Never differentiate across a pulse jump: evaluate separate left and right traces using the `PulseTrace` interface record. Return physical-time derivatives, gradients, full Hessians, Laplacians, flux-ready derivatives, segment identifiers, and side labels.
enriched_steps.what_to_do_en: For each scalar field, build a `DerivativeBundle`. Inside a smooth pulse segment, use automatic differentiation to obtain derivatives with respect to position, `tau_psi`, and every pulse component, including all mixed and second derivatives required by E3 and E4. Combine them with the first two pulse derivatives and the exact clock derivatives to form the complete first and second physical-time derivatives in E3. Form the complete `2×2` physical-space Hessian in E4, including both mixed position-clock terms, the clock-gradient outer product, and the clock Hessian. Keep the Hessian as a matrix; obtain a Laplacian only from its trace and a divergence only from the complete quantity being differentiated. At a pulse jump, evaluate separate left and right traces and never differentiate through the jump. Return all derivatives with their pulse-segment and side labels.
enriched_steps.what_to_do_zh: 为每个标量场建立 `DerivativeBundle`。在脉冲光滑分段内部，用自动微分得到相对于位置、`tau_psi` 和每个脉冲分量的导数，并保留 E3 与 E4 所需的全部混合导数和二阶导数。将它们与脉冲的一、二阶时间导数及精确时钟导数组合，严格形成 E3 的完整一阶和二阶物理时间导数。再严格按 E4 形成完整 `2×2` 物理空间黑塞矩阵，包括两项位置—时钟混合项、时钟梯度外积和时钟黑塞矩阵。黑塞矩阵始终保留为矩阵；拉普拉斯量只能由其迹得到，散度只能对完整待求导量形成。遇到脉冲跳变时分别求值左右迹，绝不跨跳变求导。返回全部导数及对应的脉冲分段和侧别标签。

enriched_steps.what_changes: At every interior point on an open pulse-smooth interval, evaluate the three entries of `R_phys` exactly as E5 with the S4 derivatives and frozen S1 functions. Evaluate `K_xi` with all declared dependencies—`T_hat`, `E_hat`, `xi_hat`, the full physical gradient of `xi_hat`, and its physical Laplacian—and form the sole auxiliary residual `r_tau` directly from the exact clock derivative and the smooth positive kinetic magnitude in E2; introduce no log transform or centering operator. Form the physics-informed neural network (PINN) objective in E5 with the frozen `s_q` and `s_tau`, nonempty initial, boundary, constitutive, and pulse-interface terms, and the clock indicator. At each pulse interface, pair records with the same physical point and edge time, impose continuity residuals for `T_hat` and `xi_hat`, and evaluate the electric boundary-value residual independently on the left and right so `V_hat` may follow the imposed step. Derive the energy-balance diagnostic separately by integrating the heat-storage, conductive-flux, and Joule terms with the physical-domain and boundary measures; report it without adding it to the training objective. Return a `ResidualBatch` with raw and normalized residual families, weights, case and interface identifiers, and the separate energy record.
enriched_steps.what_to_do_en: On every interior point inside a smooth pulse segment, evaluate the three original physical residuals exactly as E5. Evaluate `K_xi` from all of its stated inputs: temperature, electric field, phase, the full physical phase gradient, and the physical phase Laplacian. Form `r_tau` directly from the exact clock derivative and the smooth positive kinetic magnitude in E2; do not introduce a log or centering step. Build the Physics-Informed Neural Network (PINN) objective in E5 with frozen residual scales and nonempty starting, boundary, material, and pulse-interface terms. At a pulse edge, pair left and right records at the same position and time, require temperature and phase continuity, and evaluate the electrical boundary condition separately on both sides so voltage may follow the imposed step. Form energy balance separately by integrating heat storage, conductive boundary flux, and Joule heating, and report it only as a diagnostic. Return every residual family, its weights and identifiers, and the separate energy record in `ResidualBatch`.
enriched_steps.what_to_do_zh: 在脉冲光滑分段内的每个内部点，严格按 E5 求值三类原始物理残差。`K_xi` 必须接收全部声明输入：温度、电场、相态、相态的完整物理梯度和物理拉普拉斯量。严格按 E2，用精确时钟导数与平滑正动力学幅值直接形成 `r_tau`，不得加入对数变换或中心化。使用冻结残差尺度以及非空的初始、边界、本构和脉冲界面项，形成 E5 的物理信息神经网络(Physics-Informed Neural Network, PINN)目标。在脉冲边沿，把同一位置和时刻的左右记录配对，要求温度与相态连续，并在两侧分别求值电学边界条件，使电压可以跟随施加的阶跃。另行积分储热项、导热边界通量和焦耳热来形成能量平衡，只把它作为诊断报告。用 `ResidualBatch` 返回每类残差、权重与标识，以及独立的能量记录。

enriched_steps.what_changes: Create a `CapacityPlan` that counts trainable parameters in the clock and solution modules and reduces only the solution-head allocation so the KC-PINN total matches the declared reference allocation. Create one `TrainingContract` containing nonempty interior, initial, boundary, constitutive, and interface collocation identifiers; frozen residual normalizations; the joint-update rule from the first update; optimizer settings; stopping rule; and the in-distribution checkpoint selector. 【author decision: lock the admissible solution-head size family and matching tolerance, all optimizer settings, update and stopping rules, and the single in-distribution checkpoint-selection criterion applied to every arm.】 Instantiate the S5 objective without changing its terms, jointly update clock and field parameters, and save only checkpoints selected by the locked in-distribution rule. Return each checkpoint with parameter counts, collocation identifiers, residual-scale identifiers, and the exact `CapacityPlan` and `TrainingContract` versions.
enriched_steps.what_to_do_en: Build a `CapacityPlan` that counts trainable clock and solution parameters and reduces only the solution-head allocation until the Kinetics-Clock Physics-Informed Neural Network (KC-PINN) total matches the declared reference allocation. Build one `TrainingContract` with nonempty point sets for the interior, starting state, boundaries, material conditions, and pulse interfaces; frozen residual scaling; joint clock-and-field updates from the first update; optimizer settings; a stopping rule; and one in-distribution checkpoint selector. 【author decision: lock the admissible solution-head size family and matching tolerance, all optimizer settings, update and stopping rules, and the single in-distribution checkpoint-selection criterion applied to every arm.】 Train with the unchanged S5 objective and save only checkpoints chosen by that rule. Attach parameter counts, point-set identifiers, scale identifiers, and the exact plan and contract versions to every checkpoint.
enriched_steps.what_to_do_zh: 建立 `CapacityPlan`，分别统计时钟模块与解模块的可训练参数，只缩减解头的参数分配，使动力学时钟物理信息神经网络(Kinetics-Clock Physics-Informed Neural Network, KC-PINN)总量与声明的参考分配匹配。再建立统一的 `TrainingContract`，其中包含非空的内部、初始、边界、本构和脉冲界面配点标识、冻结残差归一化、从第一次更新起的时钟与场联合更新规则、优化器设置、停止规则，以及单一分布内检查点选择器。 【作者需决定：锁定允许的解头尺寸族与匹配容差、全部优化器设置、更新和停止规则，以及对所有分支统一使用的单一分布内检查点选择标准。】 使用不改变项构成的 S5 目标训练，只保存该规则选中的检查点。每个检查点都附带参数数量、配点集标识、尺度标识以及确切的计划和合同版本。

enriched_steps.what_changes: Represent every comparator as a frozen `BaselineSpec` and run it through the S1 and S6 interfaces on the same training-validation case identifiers. 【author decision: provide a versioned implementation manifest for each comparator, including source, architecture or transform, trainable parameters, loss terms, and its exact mapping to the shared physical, sampling, and checkpoint-selection contracts.】 The registry must contain: the same analytic monotone coordinate family and coefficient architecture with the complete pullback and unchanged phase residual containing `K_xi`, while only the `K_xi`-driven clock quantities `k_eff` and `r_tau` are absent; an unmodified-coordinate multilayer-perceptron PINN; fixed analytic transforms; fixed-Fourier and adaptive-spectral PINNs; causal PINN and NeuSA; self-adaptive and loss-conditional weighting; and hard-constraint and AdamFLIP comparators. Include a widened unmodified-coordinate arm whose active trainable count matches KC-PINN. For each arm, preserve the original electro-thermal-phase residual evaluator and pulse-interface handling, and return checkpoints with the same metadata schema used in S6.
enriched_steps.what_to_do_en: Describe every comparator in a frozen `BaselineSpec` and run it on the same training-validation case identifiers through the S1 and S6 interfaces. 【author decision: provide a versioned implementation manifest for each comparator, including source, architecture or transform, trainable parameters, loss terms, and its exact mapping to the shared physical, sampling, and checkpoint-selection contracts.】 Include the same analytic monotone coordinate family with the complete pullback and unchanged phase residual containing `K_xi`, while removing only the `K_xi`-driven clock quantities `k_eff` and `r_tau`; an unmodified-coordinate multilayer-perceptron PINN; fixed analytic transforms; fixed-Fourier and adaptive-spectral PINNs; causal PINN and NeuSA; self-adaptive and loss-conditional weighting; and hard-constraint and AdamFLIP comparators. Also include a widened unmodified-coordinate arm with the same active trainable count as KC-PINN. Keep the original physical residual and pulse-interface evaluator in every arm and return checkpoints in the S6 schema.
enriched_steps.what_to_do_zh: 把每个对照写成冻结的 `BaselineSpec`，并通过 S1 与 S6 接口在相同训练—验证案例标识上运行。 【作者需决定：为每个对照提供带版本的实现清单，说明来源、架构或变换、可训练参数、损失项，以及它与共享物理、采样和检查点选择合同的确切映射。】 对照集合必须包括：保留完整拉回和含 `K_xi` 的原相态残差、只移除由 `K_xi` 驱动的时钟量 `k_eff` 与 `r_tau` 的同架构解析单调坐标分支；未修改坐标的多层感知机 PINN；固定解析变换；固定傅里叶与自适应频谱 PINN；因果 PINN 与 NeuSA；自适应和损失条件加权；以及硬约束和 AdamFLIP 对照。另加入实际可训练参数数量与 KC-PINN 相同的加宽未修改坐标分支。所有分支都保留原始物理残差与脉冲界面求值器，并按 S6 的统一结构返回检查点。

enriched_steps.what_changes: Add an `identity` value to the same clock-control switch used by KC-PINN. Instantiate the identical clock tensors and parameter objects, freeze them, bypass their values with `tau_psi=t`, and set the E5 clock indicator to zero so `r_tau` is absent. Keep the identical solution-head architecture, nominal parameter allocation, collocation identifiers, residual scales, derivative and pulse-interface code, optimizer settings, update rule, stopping rule, and checkpoint selector. Record both nominal parameters and active trainable parameters; the dormant clock parameters establish nominal parity, while the widened unmodified-coordinate arm from S7 establishes active-parameter parity. Return the identity checkpoint and a `ControlTrace` containing switch state, clock-bypass confirmation, parameter counts, and the shared contract identifiers.
enriched_steps.what_to_do_en: Use the same model class with an `identity` clock setting. Create the same clock tensors and parameters, freeze them, replace their output with `tau_psi=t`, and turn off the E5 clock term so `r_tau` is absent. Keep the solution head, named point sets, residual scales, derivative and pulse-interface code, optimizer settings, update and stopping rules, and checkpoint selector unchanged. Report both nominal and active trainable parameter counts. Dormant clock parameters give nominal parity, while the widened unmodified-coordinate arm in S7 gives active-parameter parity. Return the identity checkpoint and a `ControlTrace` that records the switch, confirms the bypass, and lists shared contract identifiers.
enriched_steps.what_to_do_zh: 在同一模型类中使用 `identity` 时钟设置。建立相同的时钟张量和参数对象，将其冻结，并用 `tau_psi=t` 旁路其输出；同时把 E5 时钟指示量置零，使 `r_tau` 不出现。解头、命名配点集、残差尺度、导数与脉冲界面代码、优化器设置、更新和停止规则以及检查点选择器全部保持不变。同时报告名义参数数量和实际可训练参数数量：休眠时钟参数保证名义匹配，S7 的加宽未修改坐标分支保证实际参数匹配。返回恒等分支检查点和 `ControlTrace`，记录开关状态、旁路确认及共享合同标识。

enriched_steps.what_changes: Decode each checkpoint at requested physical times by evaluating its forward map at physical `(x,t)`; for KC-PINN this means evaluating the analytic `tau_psi(x,t)` and then `h_theta(x,tau_psi,p(t))`, with no inversion or clock-time interpolation. Store a `MetricSpec` that defines field-error alignment and norm, the switching event, phase-front extraction and Hausdorff convention, topology representation and discrepancy, energy-balance normalization, and the normalization and aggregation of coupled residuals. 【author decision: predeclare every event threshold, field norm, front level, Hausdorff and topology convention, energy normalization, and coupled-residual aggregation before finalizing the validation score.】 Evaluate the same physical-time metrics for KC-PINN, the identity arm, and every S7 comparator on training-validation cases. Use only the already declared selection rules, then freeze the architecture, `M_tau`, clock basis, hyperparameters, thresholds, metric code, and stopping and checkpoint rules in a versioned `LockedScoringContract`.
enriched_steps.what_to_do_en: Decode every checkpoint at requested physical times. For KC-PINN, evaluate the analytic `tau_psi(x,t)` and then the solution head at position, clock time, and pulse value; do not invert the clock or interpolate along clock time. Create a `MetricSpec` for field alignment and error norm, switching event, phase-front extraction and Hausdorff distance, topology representation and discrepancy, energy-balance normalization, and coupled-residual normalization and aggregation. 【author decision: predeclare every event threshold, field norm, front level, Hausdorff and topology convention, energy normalization, and coupled-residual aggregation before finalizing the validation score.】 Apply the same physical-time metrics to KC-PINN, the identity arm, and every comparator on training-validation cases.
